mainEntity.name: What types of deck railings are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hometelligent Inc. offers a variety of deck railing materials including wood, composite, vinyl, aluminum, and glass. The best type for your home depends on factors like desired aesthetic, maintenance preferences, and local building codes. For example, some homeowners in Alameda prefer wood for a classic look, while others in Berkeley opt for low-maintenance composite.
